description: 放課後の高校の陸上競技場で、陸上部の3人の生徒がそれぞれ異なる種目の練習をしている。中央では男子生徒がスターティングブロックから勢いよく飛び出して短距離走のスタート練習をしている。左側では女子生徒がハードルを跳び越え、前方を見ながら次のハードルへ向かっている。右側では別の男子生徒が走り幅跳びの砂場へ着地する瞬間で、両足を前に出してバランスを取っている。トラック脇にはストップウォッチ、練習用コーン、水筒、タオル、スポーツバッグ、巻尺などが整理され、部活動として本格的に練習している様子が伝わる。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three Japanese high school track-and-field club members practicing after school on a modern school athletics field. Do not include any additional visible athletes, coaches, spectators, or other people. The atmosphere should be energetic, disciplined, athletic, focused, and positive. All three students should wear matching school track-and-field practice uniforms, running shoes or spikes, and appropriate sports clothing. Divide the scene visually into three clearly separated training activities. In the center foreground, a teenage boy is practicing a sprint start from a pair of starting blocks on a red running track. Capture the exact moment just after he has exploded out of the blocks: his body is leaning forward, one leg is driving powerfully behind him, both arms are pumping naturally, and his eyes are focused down the lane. The starting blocks and lane markings must be clearly visible. On the left side, a teenage girl is practicing hurdles. Show her in a realistic hurdle position as she clears one hurdle: her lead leg is extended forward, her trailing leg is bent naturally, her upper body is slightly leaned forward, and she is looking toward the next hurdle. Include exactly four visible hurdles arranged evenly along the lane so that her activity is unmistakable. On the right side, another teenage boy is practicing the long jump. Show him at the moment of landing in a sand pit, with both legs extended forward, arms balancing his body, and sand lightly spraying around his shoes. Include a clearly visible takeoff board and a measuring tape beside the sand pit. Make the three actions visually distinct and physically realistic: one student accelerating from starting blocks, one student clearing hurdles, and one student landing in the long-jump pit. Include a red running track, lane numbers, starting blocks, hurdles, long-jump runway, takeoff board, sand pit, measuring tape, training cones, stopwatch on a bench, three reusable water bottles, towels, sports bags, and a small whiteboard with simple nonessential icons for sprinting, hurdles, jumping, and stretching. In the background, show a school building, green trees, field lights, and warm late-afternoon sunlight. Exactly three visible people. No additional people, no animals, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters, and no important readable text. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style with realistic proportions, highly detailed but visually organized and uncluttered, natural athletic body mechanics, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

sentences.ja: 彼はすばやくスピードを上げるため前傾しています。

sentences.ja: 彼は良い着地をするため両足を前に伸ばしています。

sentences.ja: 練習用具から、生徒たちが複数の種目を練習していることが分かります。

sentences.text: The three track-and-field club members are engaging in event-specific training designed to refine speed, coordination, and jumping technique.
sentences.grammar: 過去分詞による後置修飾
sentences.ja: 3人の陸上部員は、スピード、協調性、跳躍技術を磨くための種目別練習に取り組んでいます。

sentences.text: The sprinter is executing an explosive start by driving forcefully away from the starting blocks.
sentences.ja: 短距離選手はスターティングブロックを力強く蹴ることで、瞬発的なスタートを行っています。

sentences.text: His pronounced forward lean suggests that he is attempting to generate rapid acceleration during the opening phase of the sprint.
sentences.ja: 大きな前傾姿勢から、短距離走の序盤で急速に加速しようとしていることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: The hurdler is coordinating her lead and trailing legs while maintaining forward momentum over the obstacle.
sentences.ja: ハードル選手は前進する勢いを保ちながら、前脚と後脚を連動させています。

sentences.text: Her streamlined posture indicates that she is trying to minimize the amount of time spent in the air.
sentences.ja: 彼女の流れるような姿勢から、空中にいる時間を最小限にしようとしていることが分かります。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the long jumper is extending both legs forward and using his arms to stabilize his body during the landing.
sentences.grammar: 現在進行形 / to不定詞
sentences.ja: その一方で、走り幅跳びの選手は両足を前方に伸ばし、着地時に体を安定させるため腕を使っています。

sentences.text: The displaced sand around his feet suggests that he has just completed a forceful landing.
sentences.ja: 足元に飛び散る砂から、彼がたった今力強く着地したことがうかがえます。

sentences.text: The starting blocks, hurdles, measuring tape, and organized training equipment indicate a structured athletics practice rather than a casual exercise session.
sentences.ja: スターティングブロック、ハードル、巻尺、整理された用具から、単なる運動ではなく計画的な陸上部活動であることが分かります。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how track-and-field training requires athletes to develop speed, explosive power, coordination, technical precision, and concentration.
sentences.ja: この場面は、陸上競技の練習にスピード、瞬発力、協調性、技術的な正確さ、集中力が必要であることを示しています。
